title: APIs & Integrations
page_description: Configure email delivery and WhatsApp Business API credentials used across the admin panel.
form_description: Values saved here override .env. Leave a field empty to keep using the .env fallback. Secret fields left blank keep the current value.

email.title: Email / SMTP
email.description: Outbound mail transport. If a field is empty here, the matching MAIL_* value from .env is used.
email.mailer_hint: SMTP is recommended for production. Log writes messages to the application log.
email.password_hint: Leave blank to keep the current password (database or .env).
email.encryption_hint: Usually TLS on port 587, or SSL on port 465.
email.env_hint: Leave blank to use the .env value shown as placeholder.

whatsapp.title: WhatsApp Business API
whatsapp.description: Meta Cloud API credentials for sending WhatsApp messages. Empty fields fall back to WHATSAPP_* in .env.
whatsapp.api_token_hint: Permanent or temporary system user token. Leave blank to keep the current token.
whatsapp.webhook_verify_token_hint: Optional. Used to verify Meta webhook callbacks. Leave blank to keep the current value.
whatsapp.env_hint: Leave blank to use the .env value shown as placeholder.

gemini.title: Gemini AI Image Editing
gemini.description: Google Gemini credentials used to power AI image create/edit. Generated images can match your brand by sending the site logo from Settings > Branding.
gemini.api_key_hint: Used to authenticate requests to the Gemini API. Leave blank to keep the current key.
gemini.image_model_hint: Model used for AI image creation and editing (e.g. gemini-2.5-flash-image).
gemini.analysis_model_hint: Model used for text/image analysis (e.g. gemini-2.5-flash).

openai.title: OpenAI Content Generation
openai.description: OpenAI credentials used to power the in-editor "AI Assistant" content generator inside TinyMCE across the admin panel.
openai.api_key_hint: Used to authenticate requests to the OpenAI API. Leave blank to keep the current key.
openai.model_hint: Model used to generate editor content (e.g. gpt-4o or gpt-4o-mini).

assistant.title: Ask Symfonix AI
assistant.description: Choose which AI provider answers natural-language questions about business data. Auto uses OpenAI first, then Gemini if OpenAI is unavailable.
assistant.provider_hint: Applies only to Ask Symfonix AI. Content generation and image editing keep their own provider settings.
